sources.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: The Developer Guide- Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma 2 is designed to provide a single, compact open model released under the Apache 2.0 license, delivering exceptional multimodal performance for its size. Based on Gemma 4, this sub-1B model maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional space.

sources.title: Gemma Model Family - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: The family has two halves. A mainline generation — Gemma 1 through Gemma 4 — is the general purpose model most people want. Around each generation sits a set of variants: the same architecture retrained or restructured for one job, like embeddings, safety classification or vision-language tasks. A variant always descends from a specific generation, which is what the tree below shows.
